title: Plague-Banishing Sacred Chant (Phawar Behdeiñkhlam)
cultural_context: The sacred chant of Behdeiñkhlam celebrated by the Pnar (Jaintia) people at Jowai. Meaning 'chasing away the demon of plague and sickness', young men carry painted ritual logs (dieñkhlam) and converge at the sacred pool Aitnar to drive out evil and pray for health and harvest.
lyrics_khasi:
Hei blai heini, hei blai heitai,
Kylliang ka snem wan biang ka chaat,
Pang-khlam phet noh sha wah sha duriaw,
Khot ïa ka suk, khot ïa ka saiñ ha Jaiñtia!

Beh noh ïa u khlam, beh noh ïa ka shitom,
Pynhiar ka ksuid, pynhiar ka tympem!
Ha Aitnar ngi shad, ha Aitnar ngi nguh,
Ban roi u symbai, ban koit ka kpoh!
lyrics_english:
O God in this earthly realm, O God in the celestial heights,
With the turning of the seasons the sacred dance returns,
Let plague and pestilence flee far away into the rivers and deep ocean,
Summon peace, summon prosperous order across the land of Jaiñtia!

Drive out the pestilence, banish all suffering and pain,
Cast down the malevolent spirits into the abyss!
At sacred pool Aitnar we dance, at Aitnar we offer thanks,
That our seed crops may flourish, and the bellies of our children be nourished!

stanzas.title: Ka Jingkhot ia ka Suk (Invocation of Peace)
stanzas.khasi:
Hei blai heini, hei blai heitai,
Kylliang ka snem wan biang ka chaat,
Pang-khlam phet noh sha wah sha duriaw,
Khot ïa ka suk, khot ïa ka saiñ ha Jaiñtia!
stanzas.english: O God here and in the heavens! As the year turns the dance returns! Let pestilence flee into the ocean, summon peace and order in Jaintia!

stanzas.title: Ka Shad ha Aitnar (The Dance at Sacred Pool Aitnar)
stanzas.khasi:
Beh noh ïa u khlam, beh noh ïa ka shitom,
Pynhiar ka ksuid, pynhiar ka tympem!
Ha Aitnar ngi shad, ha Aitnar ngi nguh,
Ban roi u symbai, ban koit ka kpoh!
stanzas.english: Banish sickness and affliction! At Aitnar pool we dance and pray, so seeds flourish and the community lives in health!

vocabulary.behdeinkhlam: Driving away plague with sacred tree poles
vocabulary.aitnar: The sacred muddy pool in Jowai where the climax ritual dance takes place
vocabulary.khlam: Epidemic pestilence, plague, or widespread sickness
vocabulary.rot: Large, intricately decorated multi-tiered paper and bamboo monument carried to Aitnar
